title: Oil Sucker Liquid Blotting Paper Spray
breadcrumb: Oil Sucker Liquid Blotting Paper Spray
alt: ONE/SIZE Oil Sucker Liquid Blotting Paper Spray
description: ONE/SIZE Oil Sucker, a mattifying blotting spray available at Sephora Australia.
lede: Instant mattifying spray that blots oil, blurs shine, and resets makeup. Your mid-day touch-up in a bottle.
whatItIs: A liquid blotting spray inspired by blotting paper technology. Mist over makeup to absorb excess oil without disturbing your base.
howToUse: Hold 8–10 inches from face. Close eyes and mist in a T-zone and chin motion. Pat lightly if needed. Reapply throughout the day.
whyLove: Only at Sephora. A viral favourite for oily skin and long event days.

title: Juicepop Box Lip Tint
description: LANEIGE Juicepop Box Lip Tint, a glossy buildable lip colour.

howToUse: Apply from the applicator to bare lips or over liner. Layer for more intensity. Blot once for a softer stain.
whyLove: One of the newest drops on Sephora Australia, with K-beauty colour and serious staying power.

title: Triple Bright Purple Shampoo
description: K18 Triple Bright Purple Shampoo for oxidation defence on colour-treated hair.

whyLove: New at Sephora Australia, with salon-level toning in a travel-friendly size.

title: Soft Pinch Liquid Blush

whyLove: Only at Sephora. Sephora Australia’s most-reviewed blush for good reason.

title: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
alt: Paula's Choice Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant

whyLove: Only at Sephora. A cult classic and top-rated exfoliant on Sephora Australia.

title: Detox Shampoo
